alignments.note: Existential frame: the supplied 'there was' introduces the subject noun. Rule 63's predicate-carrier reading (putting 'there was' on the predicate nominal ἑκατοντάρχης) remains defensible, but the ASV's 'there was' is existential rather than a linking copula, so it is taken as the subject noun's helper under rule 7; the supplied indefinite 'a' is an ordinary rule 51 helper on the anarthrous noun.
Dative of respect rendered 'by name'; the case preposition rides with the noun under rule 21's determinerless clause.
Anarthrous predicate noun with rule 51's supplied indefinite as a helper.
σπείρης is anarthrous and its article follows it, so under rule 31 the determiner stays on the noun.
Postposed attributive article before the participle; the ASV supplies no relativizer for it, and the noun has already taken the determiner under rule 31, so nothing is left for it (rule 23).
Substantival adjective with the supplied determiner under rule 58's substantival clause; head on the adjective.

The italicized second 'band' repeats a noun whose source token σπείρης is already spent on t016, so it is added under rules 5 and 103. Reading it as a discontinuous second realization of σπείρης under rule 15 remains defensible.

review_notes: The supplied existential 'there was' is the one materially contested unit; rule 63 would place it on ἑκατοντάρχης instead.
t020 'band' is handled by rule 103 (repeated lexical content whose source is already realized).
